tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Every room Dubai Table books across Dubai: kind, area, which nights are Dubai Table nights, whether an exact table can be chosen, zones with seat and minimum-spend ranges, no booking fee, booking page and 360° tour links. Each venue also carries facts: what it suits (birthdays, corporate and private events, groups, date night, beach or pool day), minimum spend per person and per table, largest group, private rooms or cabanas, dress code and opening hours. Pass occasion to get only the venues that suit it, best matches first.

occasion.description: Optional. Filter to venues that suit this occasion.

party.description: Optional. Guests in the party; venues whose largest listed group is smaller are left out.

tools.name: whats_on
tools.description: The programme night by night — Dubai Table signature nights and venue nights — for the next N days from a date (default today in Dubai, 7 days, max 14).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Tables still free at a venue on a date, from the live floor plan minus tables already requested or confirmed. Filter by party size, zone or maximum minimum-spend. Each table carries its zone, seats and minimum spend in AED.

venue.description: Venue id or name (billionaire, gigi, bagatelle, lepiaf, verde, raspoutine, coucou) — or an event name like "The List".

party.description: Number of guests; returns tables seating party..party+4.

zone.description: Restrict to one zone, e.g. Stage, Terrace, Veranda.

max_min_spend.description: Only tables with a minimum spend at or under this, AED.

tools.name: show_tables
tools.description: Render the interactive table picker for a venue and night (ChatGPT / MCP Apps hosts). Same table data as the availability list, shown as a visual picker with a form for the guest to request a table and pay the platform service fee.

venue.description: Venue id or name, or an event name like "The List".

tools.name: request_table
tools.description: Place a real table request with Dubai Table. Records the request, returns a booking reference (there is no booking fee and no payment link) and alerts the guest's relationship manager, who confirms with the venue on WhatsApp. Requires the guest's name and mobile number with country code. Accepts an exact table_id, a zone, or neither (the relationship manager places the party).

venue.description: Venue id or name from list_venues or whats_on. Any venue or event listed on Dubai Table can be requested.

event.description: Optional. The event name from whats_on when the request is for a specific night.

phone.description: Guest mobile with country code, e.g. +971501234567

table_id.description: Exact table id as listed in table availability

whatsappConsent.description: True only if the guest explicitly agrees to WhatsApp booking updates from Dubai Table.

currency.description: Kept for compatibility. There is no booking fee.

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Status of a request by reference (RZ-XXXXX) and the guest's phone number: pending, confirmed, seated, cancelled.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a request by reference and phone. There is no booking fee. The relationship manager confirms on WhatsApp.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Universal Commerce Protocol checkout. Creates a checkout session for one or more table requests. line_items[].item.id uses the grammar rz:<venue>:<table_id|zone:<Zone>|any>:<YYYY-MM-DD>:<party>. Returns the full UCP checkout resource (status incomplete | ready_for_complete | requires_escalation | completed | canceled).

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Fetch a UCP checkout session by id.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace line_items and/or buyer on a UCP checkout session.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Complete a UCP checkout: places the table request(s) with Dubai Table. There is no booking fee, so the session completes without payment and the relationship manager confirms on WhatsApp.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a UCP checkout session (and its unpaid table request).

tools.name: desk_contact
tools.description: How to reach a relationship manager at Dubai Table (WhatsApp or email) for anything outside these venues, large groups, or special arrangements. Dubai Table's concierge arranges tables across all of Dubai.
